deployments_detail.use: Large-scale AI infrastructure incl. NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 (operational Jan 2026); Osaka-Sakai AI Data Center w/ Google Cloud; AI cited as earnings growth driver

deployments_detail.use: Multi-AI base station optimization using distributed reinforcement learning — multiple AI agents autonomously tune radio parameters (beam direction, power, traffic) across the commercial mobile network. [KDDI Corporation + KDDI Research (proprietary distributed reinforcement learning)]

Osaka Sakai AI data center — NVIDIA GB200 GPU AI data center (built with HPE on the former Sharp Sakai plant) providing GPU compute for AI development/training including trillion-parameter models; commenced operations. [NVIDIA GB200 GPUs, HPE]
Azure OpenAI Service used to summarize and prepare middle-office sales work [Microsoft] [Microsoft]
deployments_detail.value: Cut middle-office sales preparation work by 74%

deployments_detail.use: au Support AI Advisor 'Nagisa' — a generative-AI digital human avatar handling au customer support inquiries (voice, text, images) online, launched to consumers on the service page. [KDDI + Digital Human (generative AI + digital human avatar)]

Middle-office sales-prep automation: a system that imports past PowerPoint sales materials into Azure to generate slide images/summaries and speed information gathering for sales staff. In production after beta (Jun-Sep 2024). [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service (GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini), Entra ID, SharePoint Online]

KDDI Conata Data Agent — secure AI-powered internal document search and analysis assistant letting employees query internal data (PDFs, tables, customer records, project materials) in natural language over a closed network. [KDDI Conata + Flywheel (retrieval) + generative AI, over Wide Area Virtual Switch 2 closed network]

KDDI x Google Cloud AI partnership — MoU/collaboration to accelerate AI use and talent development across the KDDI Group (incl. 'KDDI AI Agent Day' internal enablement with Google Cloud). [Google Cloud (Gemini / Vertex AI)]
KDDI AI Security Portal — service that organizes, classifies and centralizes the latest web information on attack and defense methods against AI systems, for security teams. [KDDI]

Fault Recovery support Agent — an AI agent for cloud-service operations that immediately identifies fault root cause by correlating affected services/systems, equipment alarms, and maintenance operations. [Amazon Bedrock / Amazon Bedrock Agents]
